title: Boundary Layers and One-point Functions in the Presence of Monodromy Defects
summary: We study one-point functions of composites of charge $e$ operators in the presence of a monodromy defect for a $U(1)$ global symmetry with monodromy $β$. We first compute these in free massless and massive theories, recovering in the former case the known $\sin(eπβ)$ dependence and obtaining in the latter a $\sin^2(eπβ)$ dependence. We then turn to holography and compute 1-point functions for operators $O$ of charge $J=Δ$ in $\mathfrak{su}(N)$ $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM in the presence of a monodromy defect for a $U(1)\in SO(6)_R$.
